data.content: Book statuses & ASINs: Tomorrow Remembered (B0GX2XC5YF, $3.99/$9.99), AI That Works for Small Business (B0H15NLBW8, $2.99/$9.99), Built from Dust NBS1 (B0GX2YJ92K, $2.99/$9.99), Owner's Manual for AI Agents (B0H1KSCRYC, $3.99/$8.99) — all published. No Blue Sky 2-5 + Lunar Foundation 1-3 — Coming Soon.

Book page count target: 175-225 pages per book at 6x9in. No front/back cover on V2.0 files. Series transitions describe the series and list all Amazon-available books.

TOC word-wrap is FORBIDDEN. Every TOC entry MUST be on a single line. Use table-layout:fixed, white-space:nowrap on titles, overflow:hidden+text-overflow:ellipsis. Never use float-based TOC or target-counter in WeasyPrint. Extract chapter titles from h1/h2/title tags—never from filenames.

USB 4TB drive at /mnt/usb_4tb (UUID 5b794b72-6d5f-44ac-a97e-5978ee5220b1, ext4, nofail). Contains: backups/, archives/, books/ (symlinked from ~/books), project-dirs/ (business, Developer, hermes, hermes-scripts, mifeco_web, saas, workspace-engineering — each symlinked from ~/). Backup skill updated to write to /mnt/usb_4tb/backups/.

KDP Specs: Cover JPEG 2560×1600 RGB. Print PDF 300DPI, 6x9" trim, 0.125" bleed. Spine: pages×0.002252"(white). eBook EPUB3 650MB max. TOC: MUST use <pre> tag with white-space:pre. Table/flex layouts DO NOT WORK in WeasyPrint. 2-pass render: pass 1 without page numbers, extract via pdftotext, pass 2 with hardcoded numbers. Extract titles from h1/h2/title tags (never filenames). Strip prefix with — entity. See references/toc-template.md in book-deliverable-kdp skill.

Image gen: openrouter-image-generation-workflow skill. Flux.2 and Gemini Flash Image models. API key in env OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Sci-fi books: pencil sketch scene illustrations (one per chapter). Business books: matplotlib infographics. Memoir: simple diagrams.

User refers to the agent as "hermes". Published author (Bob J Mills) with two sci-fi series on KDP: No Blue Sky (5 books) and Lunar Foundation (4 books). Also writes business/guide books. Communicates via Telegram. Detail-oriented: author name must be exact "Bob J Mills" (not variants), PDFs must have TOCs, fabricated claims must be reframed as honest case studies. Prefers compact series descriptions under 4K chars. Expects leads to actually advance through pipeline stages when emails are "sent" — not just marked as sent in localStorage. Wants test/production separation: test mode writes to a mock inbox, production mode sends live via DreamHost SMTP. Frustrated when the dashboard fakes action without real effect. Wants the outreach dashboard accessible from mifeco.com/wp-admin.
